grandparents_cupboard.reason: Flour, oats, eggs, yoghurt, oil, honey, clementines and carrots are all plain home-kitchen ingredients.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any Tesco.

basic_kitchen.reason: A loaf tin, bowl, whisk and grater are ordinary kit, and stirring a quick bread is beginner technique.

works.reason: The 300g of dry ingredients balance the eggs, yoghurt, oil, honey, juice and grated carrot for a moist loaf, and 50 to 55 minutes at 180°C suits a 900g tin.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers zesting, juicing, grating two carrots, slicing a clementine and mixing, and the 55-minute bake matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, and nothing unlisted appears in the steps.

seasonal_feel.reason: Clementines are at their best in early February, and their zest, juice and sliced topping make them the point of the loaf.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholemeal flour, oats, eggs, yoghurt and carrot with modest honey make a filling breakfast loaf rather than a cake.
